headline: Figma coverage went 13 -> 50 of 51 after the first real REST enumeration of the published library (52 pages, 121 assets; a prior hand-walk had found 13 pages and missed 38 published components). Counting from the Figma side exposed two discovery bugs that counting from code never could: getExportedValueNames ignored ExportDeclaration, so every compound component built with Object.assign and exported via `export { X }` was invisible to the manifest, and findJsDocBlock had the same blind spot, so tags written on those components were silently dropped. Fixing both took the manifest from 113 to 132 components — 19 the system did not know it had. New tooling: pnpm figma:inventory (REST enumeration, committed as figma/inventory.json), pnpm check:figma-coverage (gates from the Figma side), pnpm guardrail:sweep (runs all 54 gates on demand). ADR-026 lets agents write Figma via a staging duplicate; ADR-027 deleted the gate firing telemetry, which measured 1 gate of 54 and backfilled the other 36 with a single date, and had nearly justified deleting 8 working gates.
